title: New Ballet San Jose
specs: Only ABT Certified Ballet School in the San Jose area
Offers over $90,000 in scholarships and financial aid annually
Studio Company performs with Symphony San Jose and in world premiere productions
Summer Intensive Level A: New Ballet students Levels 2B–3B or serious ballet students with 3+ years training
Summer Intensive Level B: New Ballet students Levels 4–6 with minimum 3 years pointe training and 5+ days/week training
Four Week Intensive: Ages 10–23, training 3–5 days/week, placement by audition or assessment recommended
Studio Company Apprentice: Advanced dancers ages 16–20 preparing for professional transition
Studio Company: Advanced dancers ages 17–24, full-time program with performance and training commitments
Studio rentals available for rehearsals, auditions, private classes, workshops, photo shoots, and gatherings
Studio Company and Apprentice programs are full-day, performance-focused training programs

includes: Studios have mirrors, marley floors, and setup for phones/computers
Studio Mohr has state of the art lighting for streaming and video productions at additional cost
Summer Intensive includes ballet technique, pointe, men's class, variations, repertoire, and supplemental classes
Studio Company Apprentice program includes tuition and participation in school activities

blurb: New Ballet offers ballet performances and training including summer intensives, school year classes, and professional company programs. They provide studio rentals for rehearsals and events. Their training programs follow the American Ballet Theatre National Training Curriculum and include divisions from pre-ballet to senior pre-professional and company apprenticeships.
extraNote: No audition required for Summer Intensive enrollment; auditions required for merit scholarships and company consideration · Merit and need-based scholarships available but limited · Studio Company Apprentice includes tuition; Studio Company may include small weekly stipend after first year · Contract meetings in February; leave of absence possible with approval for professional opportunities · Located in Downtown San Jose, housed in the Corinthian Ballroom, entrance down the ramp to right side of the building.
